entries.label_vi: Biện pháp môi trường nghiêm ngặt làm tăng chi phí doanh nghiệp, chậm tăng trưởng ngắn hạn
entries.claim: Strict environmental measures can raise costs for businesses and slow short-term growth.
entries.because: Factories must install cleaner equipment, and firms may respond by raising prices or cutting jobs, which matters most in poorer countries where growth is needed to lift people out of poverty.
entries.result: Hardship and political opposition follow if rules are too sudden.
entries.reuse_vi: Phía ưu tiên kinh tế trong đề kinh tế vs môi trường.

entries.label_vi: Bỏ qua môi trường về lâu dài còn đắt hơn (lũ, hạn, ô nhiễm, dọn dẹp)
entries.claim: Ignoring the environment is expensive in the long run.
entries.because: Floods, droughts and polluted air damage crops, homes and health, and the cost of cleaning up afterwards is usually far higher than the cost of preventing the damage.
entries.result: Growth built on damage cannot last.
entries.reuse_vi: Phía ưu tiên môi trường / chính sách khí hậu.

entries.label_vi: Chính sách môi trường cũng tạo tăng trưởng và việc làm
entries.claim: Environmental policy can itself create growth and employment.
entries.because: Renewable energy, insulation and recycling employ workers and encourage new technology.
entries.result: Clean industries can be sold abroad as well as used at home.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề năng lượng tái tạo tạo việc làm, công nghệ xanh.

entries.label_vi: Bên gây ô nhiễm phải trả chi phí khắc phục
entries.claim: Corporations that profit from an activity should bear the cost of its damage.
entries.because: When the clean-up falls on taxpayers the company profits while the public pays, whereas fines and taxes make firms include environmental costs in their prices.
entries.result: Firms then have a reason to adopt cleaner methods.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề trách nhiệm doanh nghiệp.

entries.label_vi: Bằng chứng khoa học gắn nóng lên với hoạt động con người
entries.claim: Scientific evidence links the recent rise in temperatures to human activity.
entries.because: Burning coal, oil and gas and clearing forests release gases that trap heat, and temperatures have risen alongside emissions since the industrial era began.
entries.result: Natural cycles that operate over thousands of years cannot explain such rapid warming.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nguyên nhân biến đổi khí hậu.

entries.label_vi: Yếu tố tự nhiên: núi lửa, chu kỳ mặt trời, dòng hải lưu
entries.claim: The climate has always changed through natural causes.
entries.because: Volcanic eruptions, variations in the sun's energy and shifts in ocean currents produced warm periods and ice ages long before humans existed.
entries.result: Some people therefore argue that today's warming may be part of a natural cycle.
entries.reuse_vi: Phía nguyên nhân tự nhiên.

entries.label_vi: Thích ứng: bảo vệ người dân khỏi tác hại đang xảy ra (đê, cảnh báo sớm, cây chịu hạn)
entries.claim: Adaptation protects people from harm that is already happening.
entries.because: Sea walls, flood defences, drought-resistant crops and early warning systems save lives and homes within a few years, whereas cuts in emissions take decades to change the climate.
entries.result: Countries that produce little pollution but suffer its effects are helped most.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thích ứng vs giảm thiểu khí hậu.

entries.label_vi: Giảm thiểu: cắt phát thải tại nguồn, thích ứng chỉ chữa triệu chứng
entries.claim: Adaptation alone only treats the symptoms.
entries.because: Cutting emissions at their source through renewable energy, efficient buildings and cleaner transport reduces the scale of the problem, whereas defences become more expensive as temperatures rise.
entries.result: Prevention is far cheaper than dealing with the consequences later.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thích ứng vs giảm thiểu khí hậu.

entries.label_vi: Ngân sách có hạn, nhiều ưu tiên cấp bách khác (y tế, giáo dục, nhà ở)
entries.claim: Governments have limited funds and many equally urgent responsibilities.
entries.because: Hospitals, schools, housing and welfare all need money now, and people cannot wait for the long-term benefits of climate policy.
entries.result: In poorer countries spending heavily on emissions cuts may seem a luxury.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề chi tiêu chính phủ: môi trường vs ưu tiên khác.

entries.text: A developing country that bans cheap coal before it has an alternative, for example, may leave millions of households without affordable electricity.
A government that allows a river to become heavily polluted, for example, must later pay for water treatment and for the illnesses that follow.
A city that invests in clean transport, for instance, reduces hospital costs from air pollution while creating jobs in construction and maintenance.
A chemical company that knows it will pay for any spill, for example, will invest more in safety.
A coastal town that builds a flood barrier, for example, protects its residents from the next storm, whatever the world does about emissions.

entries.label_vi: Năng lượng tái tạo sạch hơn than, dầu, khí; ít khí nhà kính, không khói hại phổi
entries.claim: Renewable energy is cleaner than coal, oil and gas.
entries.because: Solar panels and wind turbines produce electricity without burning fuel, so they release almost no greenhouse gases and none of the smoke that harms people's lungs in crowded cities.
entries.result: The air is cleaner and hospitals treat fewer patients with breathing problems.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề năng lượng tái tạo, ô nhiễm không khí.

entries.label_vi: Giảm phụ thuộc nhiên liệu nhập khẩu, nguồn cung ổn định hơn
entries.claim: Investing in renewables makes a country less dependent on imported fuel.
entries.because: Nations that buy oil and gas from abroad are exposed to sudden price rises and political disputes, whereas home-grown wind and solar power gives them a more stable and secure supply.
entries.result: The economy is shielded from external shocks.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lợi ích của năng lượng tái tạo / an ninh năng lượng.

entries.label_vi: Chi phí điện mặt trời / gió giảm nhờ công nghệ, sản xuất quy mô lớn, cạnh tranh
entries.claim: The cost of solar and wind equipment has fallen as the technology has improved.
entries.because: As manufacturers build larger factories and produce more equipment, each panel or turbine costs less to make, and competition pushes prices down.
entries.result: Clean power can now compete with coal and gas in many places without large subsidies.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề chi phí năng lượng tái tạo giảm.

entries.label_vi: Nắng gió không ổn định → cần pin lưu trữ, lưới điện linh hoạt, nguồn dự phòng
entries.claim: The sun does not always shine and the wind does not always blow.
entries.because: Supply from renewables varies from hour to hour, so grids need batteries, flexible demand and backup power to stay reliable.
entries.result: These costs are real but falling as storage improves.
entries.reuse_vi: Nhược điểm / giới hạn của năng lượng tái tạo.

entries.label_vi: Công nghiệp nặng, hàng không, vận tải biển khó chạy bằng điện; nước đang phát triển còn dựa vào than
entries.claim: Heavy industry, aviation and shipping are hard to run on electricity.
entries.because: Steel, cement and long-distance transport need very high temperatures or dense, light fuels, and many developing countries still rely on cheap coal and oil to grow.
entries.result: Replacement of fossil fuels will be uneven and gradual rather than sudden.
entries.reuse_vi: Giới hạn của việc thay thế nhiên liệu hoá thạch.

entries.label_vi: Điện tái tạo cần nhiều lao động: sản xuất, xây dựng, lắp đặt, bảo trì
entries.claim: Building and running renewable energy requires a wide range of workers.
entries.because: Factories make panels and turbine blades, construction crews build wind farms and solar parks, electricians install equipment and technicians repair machines for decades afterwards.
entries.result: Many of these jobs are located in local communities, which spreads the benefit widely.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề đầu tư năng lượng tái tạo tạo việc làm.

entries.text: A city that replaces a coal power station with wind and solar farms, for example, can breathe cleaner air within a few years.
A household that fits solar panels today, for example, pays much less than a neighbour did a decade ago.
A factory that makes steel, for instance, cannot switch to wind power in a few years.
A town that hosts a new wind farm, for example, may gain hundreds of jobs during construction and a smaller number of permanent posts for maintenance.

entries.label_vi: Điện hạt nhân: sản lượng lớn, ổn định ngày đêm, gần như không phát thải carbon
entries.claim: Nuclear plants produce large amounts of low-carbon electricity.
entries.because: A single plant can run day and night whatever the weather, and a small amount of fuel produces a great deal of energy, so it provides steady power while releasing almost no greenhouse gases.
entries.result: Countries reduce their dependence on imported coal and gas.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề năng lượng hạt nhân (ưu điểm).

entries.label_vi: Tai nạn hạt nhân hiếm nhưng hậu quả nghiêm trọng, lâu dài (Chernobyl, Fukushima)
entries.claim: The consequences of a nuclear accident can be severe and long-lasting.
entries.because: The disasters at Chernobyl and Fukushima forced thousands of people to leave their homes, and some areas remained unusable for years.
entries.result: Many citizens feel uneasy about living near a plant.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề hạt nhân (rủi ro an toàn).

entries.label_vi: Chất thải phóng xạ phải lưu trữ hàng nghìn năm; nhà máy đắt, xây lâu, vượt ngân sách
entries.claim: Radioactive waste must be stored safely for thousands of years.
entries.because: This places a burden on future generations, and plants are very expensive and often take over a decade to build, so they may be late and over budget.
entries.result: Poorer countries may struggle to provide the strict regulation and trained staff needed.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề hạt nhân (chất thải, chi phí).

entries.label_vi: Công nghệ xanh vừa cải thiện môi trường vừa tiết kiệm tiền (hiệu quả năng lượng)
entries.claim: Green technology improves the environment while saving money.
entries.because: Efficient buildings, appliances and factories use less energy, so they reduce both pollution and bills, and the country spends less on imported fuel and on treating illnesses caused by dirty air.
entries.result: Early investment pays off in the long term.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lợi ích của công nghệ xanh / giao thông xanh.

entries.label_vi: Giao thông tái tạo: không khói thải, không khí sạch hơn, ít ồn, tốt cho sức khoẻ
entries.claim: Renewable transport improves air quality and public health.
entries.because: Electric buses and cars produce no exhaust fumes on the road, and when their power comes from wind or solar they release far fewer greenhouse gases over their lifetime.
entries.result: Residents of crowded cities breathe cleaner air and noise levels fall.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giao thông xanh / ô nhiễm đô thị.

entries.label_vi: Nhiên liệu sinh học giảm phát thải giao thông, dùng được trong động cơ hiện có
entries.claim: Biofuels can reduce the carbon emissions of transport.
entries.because: Plants absorb carbon dioxide as they grow, so in theory the fuel releases about the same amount that it removed from the air, and it can be used in existing engines with little change.
entries.result: Countries can cut emissions from millions of cars quickly and depend less on imported oil.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nhiên liệu sinh học (ưu điểm).

entries.label_vi: Cây nhiên liệu cạnh tranh đất với lương thực, đẩy giá, phá rừng
entries.claim: Biofuels raise serious concerns about land and food.
entries.because: Fuel crops need farmland, so they may compete with food production and push up prices, and if forests are cleared to plant them the carbon released can cancel out the benefits.
entries.result: Poorer families are hurt most; fuel made from waste avoids many problems but supplies are limited.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nhiên liệu sinh học (nhược điểm), nông nghiệp.

entries.text: A country with several reactors, for example, can keep its lights on during a calm, cloudy week without burning fossil fuels.
A city that replaces diesel buses with electric ones, for example, enjoys quieter streets and cleaner air, and its transport company spends less on fuel in the long run.
A country that becomes known for efficient batteries, for instance, can sell them to many others.

entries.label_vi: Nhựa tồn tại hàng thế kỷ, vỡ thành vi nhựa, hại động vật biển, vào chuỗi thức ăn
entries.claim: Plastic persists in the environment for centuries.
entries.because: Single-use items rarely decompose; instead they break into tiny pieces called microplastics, which are found in rivers, soil and even the food that people eat.
entries.result: Marine animals swallow plastic or become trapped in it, and cleaning up afterwards is extremely difficult and costly.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề cấm nhựa dùng một lần, ô nhiễm đại dương.

entries.label_vi: Lệnh cấm hiệu quả khi có phương án thay thế (túi vải, ống hút kim loại, chai dùng lại); phí túi nhựa làm giảm mạnh việc dùng
entries.claim: Bans work when alternatives exist.
entries.because: Paper bags, cloth shopping bags, metal straws and reusable bottles perform the same function and can be used many times, and a small charge for plastic bags sharply reduced their use in several countries.
entries.result: People adapt quickly once the habit is changed.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề cấm nhựa, giảm bao bì.

entries.label_vi: Lệnh cấm không đủ: vật thay thế tốn năng lượng, khó thực thi, nguồn nhựa khác vẫn gây ô nhiễm
entries.claim: Bans are not enough on their own.
entries.because: Some substitutes such as paper or thick cotton bags need more energy to produce, enforcement can be weak among small sellers, and plastic from other sources continues to pollute.
entries.result: Bans should be combined with deposit schemes, better recycling and public education.
entries.reuse_vi: Giới hạn của lệnh cấm / nhượng bộ.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: đặt cọc vỏ chai, phí túi nhựa, buộc nhà sản xuất trả phí thu gom
entries.claim: Deposit schemes and charges change habits.
entries.because: When customers receive a small refund for returning bottles, return rates rise, and a charge on disposable items encourages people to bring their own.
entries.result: Bottles stay out of the environment and the material is reused instead of wasted.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giảm rác nhựa / rác thải.

entries.label_vi: Nhiều bao bì thừa: bọc nhiều lớp, hộp quá lớn, phục vụ tiếp thị hơn là bảo vệ
entries.claim: Much packaging exists for marketing rather than protection.
entries.because: Attractive boxes, extra layers and oversized containers make products look more valuable, but they are thrown away as soon as the item is opened.
entries.result: Over a year such small choices add up to huge quantities of rubbish.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề bao bì thừa, lãng phí.

entries.label_vi: Bao bì cần thiết bảo vệ thực phẩm, vệ sinh, kéo dài hạn dùng → giảm lãng phí thức ăn
entries.claim: Some packaging is necessary.
entries.because: It protects food from damage, keeps it hygienic and can extend its shelf life, which reduces food waste, and fragile goods need protection in transport.
entries.result: The answer is to design packaging better rather than to abolish it.
entries.reuse_vi: Nhượng bộ trong đề bao bì.

entries.label_vi: Quy chuẩn thiết kế: cỡ nhỏ nhất phù hợp, vật liệu tái chế, nhà sản xuất trả phí rác
entries.claim: Producers should be required to pay for the waste they create.
entries.because: This encourages them to design simpler, recyclable packaging, using the smallest suitable size and materials that can be reused or recycled.
entries.result: Waste falls at its source instead of being managed afterwards.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giới hạn bao bì / trách nhiệm nhà sản xuất.

entries.text: A beach covered with bottles and bags, for example, harms wildlife and also discourages tourists, which damages the local economy.
When shops in several countries introduced a small charge for plastic bags, for instance, their use fell sharply.

entries.text: A cucumber wrapped in plastic, for example, already has its own natural skin, so the extra layer adds waste without adding protection.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: làm tái chế dễ dàng (thùng mã màu, thu gom định kỳ, điểm tái chế, nhãn rõ ràng)
entries.claim: Governments should make recycling convenient.
entries.because: Households are more likely to sort their rubbish if collection is regular, bins are clearly marked and the rules are simple.
entries.result: Only governments can build the sorting plants and collection networks that make recycling practical.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề khuyến khích tái chế.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: tạo động lực (đặt cọc, giảm phí cho hộ ít rác, bắt buộc dùng vật liệu tái chế, giáo dục)
entries.claim: Authorities should give people good reasons to take part in recycling.
entries.because: Deposit schemes raise return rates sharply, lower charges reward households that produce less general waste, and requiring manufacturers to use recycled material creates a market for what households collect.
entries.result: Participation rises and the system pays for itself.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề tái chế / rác thải.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp rác vứt bừa: nhiều thùng rác dễ thấy, dọn thường xuyên, thùng phân loại có biểu tượng
entries.claim: Governments should make proper disposal easy.
entries.because: People are more likely to use a bin if one is close by, so councils should place well-marked bins in busy streets and empty them often so they do not overflow.
entries.result: Clean surroundings also set an example, because people tend to drop rubbish where litter already exists.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề rác nơi công cộng.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp rác vứt bừa: phạt rõ ràng, tuần tra / camera, lao động công ích, giáo dục
entries.claim: Authorities should discourage careless behaviour.
entries.because: Visible fines supported by patrols or cameras in problem areas make people think twice, and public campaigns explain the harm that litter causes to animals and neighbourhoods.
entries.result: Combined with more bins and a deposit scheme, litter may fall sharply within a year.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề rác nơi công cộng.

entries.label_vi: Tái chế bắt buộc: tăng tỷ lệ tham gia, thành thói quen; cần dịch vụ thuận tiện và thực thi hợp lý
entries.claim: Mandatory recycling creates much higher participation.
entries.because: When recycling is optional many people ignore it because it takes effort and the benefit seems small, whereas a clear legal requirement turns it into a normal habit, as seat belts became normal once compulsory.
entries.result: Compulsion works only if people are given the means to comply: convenient collection, clear instructions and warnings before penalties.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề tái chế bắt buộc.

entries.label_vi: Nguyên nhân lãng phí thực phẩm: mua quá nhiều, hiểu sai nhãn hạn dùng, loại bỏ nông sản xấu mã, khẩu phần lớn
entries.claim: Overbuying and strict rules about appearance and dates are major causes of food waste.
entries.because: Shoppers buy more than they need, attracted by bulk offers; many misunderstand date labels; and supermarkets reject fruit and vegetables of the wrong size or shape, while restaurants serve portions that are too large.
entries.result: Edible food is wasted before anyone has a chance to eat it.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lãng phí thực phẩm.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: nhãn rõ ràng, bán nông sản xấu mã giá rẻ, chuyển thực phẩm dư cho ngân hàng thực phẩm, giáo dục, thu gom rác thực phẩm
entries.claim: Governments should require clearer labels and encourage retailers to pass on surplus food.
entries.because: Selling imperfect produce at lower prices and giving unsold but edible food to charities means that surplus feeds people instead of landfill.
entries.result: Families also cut their grocery bills.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lãng phí thực phẩm.

entries.label_vi: Vòng đời ngắn tăng khai thác, sản xuất, rác điện tử; văn hoá vứt đi
entries.claim: Making a new product uses large amounts of energy, water and raw materials.
entries.because: Most of a phone's environmental impact comes from mining and manufacturing rather than daily use, so replacing it after two years instead of five increases that impact.
entries.result: Cheap, quickly outdated goods encourage a throwaway culture and fill landfill sites.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề vòng đời sản phẩm, bảo hành, thời trang nhanh.

entries.label_vi: Bảo hành dài buộc nhà sản xuất làm đồ bền, dễ sửa; sửa chữa thành lựa chọn bình thường
entries.claim: Longer warranties give manufacturers a reason to build durable goods.
entries.because: If a company must repair or replace its products for five years instead of one, it will use stronger parts and better testing, because failures become costly.
entries.result: Fewer items are made and discarded, and repair becomes the normal choice.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề bảo hành, vòng đời, sửa chữa.

entries.text: A resident with no collection point nearby, for example, has little chance of recycling even when they want to.
A park with a bin every fifty metres, for example, will usually be cleaner than one with only a few.
A bag of misshapen carrots that never reaches the shelf, for example, is wasted before anyone has a chance to eat it.
A washing machine with a ten-year guarantee, for example, is likely to be built to last, and its owner does not need to buy a replacement after two years.

entries.label_vi: Cây biến đổi gen: năng suất cao hơn, chịu hạn và sâu bệnh, giảm thuốc trừ sâu, thêm vi chất
entries.claim: Genetically modified crops can produce higher and more reliable yields.
entries.because: Plants can be changed to resist pests, tolerate drought or contain extra vitamins, so farmers lose less of their harvest and need fewer chemicals.
entries.result: More food is grown on the same land, which helps a growing population.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề cây trồng biến đổi gen, đổi mới nông nghiệp.

entries.label_vi: Cây biến đổi gen: chưa rõ tác động dài hạn, lệ thuộc công ty hạt giống, gen lan sang cây dại
entries.claim: The long-term effects of genetically modified crops are not fully known.
entries.because: Modified genes could spread to wild plants, and farmers who buy patented seed each year become dependent on a few large companies.
entries.result: Many consumers distrust modified food, so careful testing and clear labels are needed.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề cây biến đổi gen (nhược điểm).

entries.label_vi: Đổi mới nông nghiệp (tưới nhỏ giọt, nông nghiệp chính xác, giống tốt): tăng sản lượng, tiết kiệm nước và hoá chất
entries.claim: Agricultural innovation allows farmers to produce more with fewer resources.
entries.because: Drip irrigation, sensors and better seeds deliver water and fertiliser exactly where plants need them, so yields rise while waste falls.
entries.result: Higher farm incomes strengthen rural communities and food supplies.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lợi ích đổi mới nông nghiệp / tập trung vào nông nghiệp.

entries.label_vi: An ninh lương thực, việc làm nông thôn, thu nhập xuất khẩu
entries.claim: A strong farming sector protects a country's food security.
entries.because: A country that grows its own food depends less on imports and is less exposed to price shocks, and farming provides jobs and export income in rural areas.
entries.result: Rural communities stay stable and fewer people move to crowded cities.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lợi ích của nông nghiệp.

entries.label_vi: Nông nghiệp đô thị: thực phẩm tươi tại chỗ, ít vận chuyển, dùng mái nhà và đất trống, gắn kết cộng đồng
entries.claim: Urban farming brings fresh food closer to the people who eat it.
entries.because: Rooftop gardens, vertical farms and community plots use empty space in cities, cut transport distances and give residents access to fresh vegetables.
entries.result: Local food costs less to deliver and strengthens community ties.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nông nghiệp đô thị / vườn cộng đồng.

entries.label_vi: Nông nghiệp đô thị: sản lượng lương thực chính hạn chế, chi phí cao, thiếu đất và nước
entries.claim: Urban farms cannot grow enough staple crops to end food shortages.
entries.because: Cities lack the land and water needed for wheat, rice and maize, and high rents and energy costs make indoor farms expensive.
entries.result: Urban farming can supplement but not replace rural agriculture.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nông nghiệp đô thị (giới hạn).

entries.label_vi: Thuốc trừ sâu bảo vệ mùa màng, giữ năng suất, giá lương thực thấp
entries.claim: Pesticides protect crops from insects, weeds and disease.
entries.because: Without them farmers could lose a large share of their harvest, which would raise food prices and leave more people hungry.
entries.result: Food is cheaper and more reliably available.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thuốc trừ sâu.

entries.label_vi: Thuốc trừ sâu: dư lượng hại sức khoẻ, hại ong, nhiễm nguồn nước, sâu bệnh kháng thuốc
entries.claim: Pesticides can harm people, wildlife and water.
entries.because: Residues may stay on food, chemicals wash into rivers and kill useful insects such as bees, and pests gradually become resistant.
entries.result: Integrated pest management and careful use can reduce the harm.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thuốc trừ sâu (nhược điểm).

entries.label_vi: Nhãn nguồn gốc thực phẩm: người mua biết xuất xứ, an toàn, ủng hộ nông dân địa phương, chọn lựa đạo đức
entries.claim: Labels showing where food comes from help shoppers to make informed choices.
entries.because: Buyers can support local farmers, avoid products linked to poor safety records or long transport, and trace the source if a problem occurs.
entries.result: Producers have a reason to meet higher standards.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nhãn sản phẩm / minh bạch.

entries.label_vi: Nông nghiệp hữu cơ: ít hoá chất, đất khoẻ, đa dạng sinh học; nhưng năng suất thấp, giá cao, cần nhiều đất
entries.claim: Organic farming reduces chemical use and protects soil and wildlife.
entries.because: Farmers avoid synthetic pesticides and fertilisers, which keeps soil healthy and supports biodiversity, although yields are lower and prices higher.
entries.result: Large-scale support may make sense only where benefits are clear.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề chi tiêu cho nông nghiệp hữu cơ.

entries.label_vi: Nước sạch: giảm bệnh, giúp trẻ (nhất là bé gái) đi học, tăng năng suất lao động
entries.claim: Clean water protects health and frees time for education and work.
entries.because: Safe drinking water prevents diseases such as diarrhoea, and families no longer spend hours collecting water, so children can attend school and adults can work.
entries.result: Healthier, better-educated people make the economy more productive.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nước sạch.

entries.text: A farmer who plants a drought-resistant variety, for example, may still harvest a reasonable crop in a dry year.
A farm that switches from flooding its fields to drip irrigation, for example, can grow the same crop with far less water.
A village that gains a safe tap, for example, sees fewer children miss school because of stomach illness, and girls no longer spend hours carrying water.

entries.label_vi: Động vật cảm nhận đau đớn; luật yếu cho phép tàn ác; luật mạnh đặt chuẩn tối thiểu và hình phạt
entries.claim: Animals can feel pain and fear, so they deserve legal protection.
entries.because: Weak laws allow cruelty on farms, in circuses and in laboratories, whereas strong laws set minimum standards of care and penalties for those who break them.
entries.result: Treatment of animals improves and public standards rise.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề luật bảo vệ động vật.

entries.label_vi: Luật bảo vệ động vật mạnh có lợi cho xã hội: giáo dục lòng nhân ái, thực phẩm an toàn hơn, du lịch
entries.claim: Stricter animal protection laws benefit society as well as animals.
entries.because: Respect for animals teaches children compassion, better conditions on farms reduce disease risks and improve food safety, and countries with good records attract responsible tourists.
entries.result: The cost to farmers can be reduced with time and support.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lợi ích xã hội của luật động vật.

entries.label_vi: Bảo tồn động vật hoang dã mang lại dịch vụ hệ sinh thái (thụ phấn, nước sạch, chống lũ), du lịch, thuốc
entries.claim: Wildlife conservation improves people's lives in practical ways.
entries.because: Healthy ecosystems pollinate crops, clean water and reduce floods, nature tourism creates jobs, and wild plants and animals provide the basis for new medicines.
entries.result: Communities near protected areas often gain income and a more reliable environment.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề bảo tồn thiên nhiên / lợi ích cho con người.

entries.label_vi: Đại dương xuyên biên giới, cung cấp oxy và thực phẩm, điều hoà khí hậu; cần hợp tác quốc tế
entries.claim: The ocean is a shared resource that no single country can protect alone.
entries.because: Fish stocks, currents and pollution cross borders, the sea provides food for billions of people and helps to regulate the climate and produce oxygen.
entries.result: Overfishing and plastic waste in one region harm coastlines far away.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề bảo vệ đại dương.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp không gian xanh đô thị: bảo vệ đất xanh, yêu cầu công viên trong dự án mới, mái xanh, cây đường phố, bảo trì
entries.claim: Governments can protect and expand green space inside cities.
entries.because: Planning rules can protect existing parks, require new developments to include gardens, and encourage green roofs and street trees where land is scarce.
entries.result: Residents gain cooler, cleaner and more pleasant surroundings.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề cải thiện công viên / không gian xanh.

entries.label_vi: Vườn công cộng: sức khoẻ, làm mát, đa dạng sinh học, di sản, gắn kết; nhà ở có thể xây trên đất trống khác
entries.claim: Public gardens give city residents health, shade and a place to meet.
entries.because: They cool the air, absorb pollution, shelter birds and insects and offer free space to rest and exercise, and once built over they are almost impossible to replace.
entries.result: Housing can usually be built on empty or abandoned sites instead.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề bảo vệ công viên / bãi biển khỏi phát triển.

entries.label_vi: Vườn cộng đồng: rau tươi, gắn kết, giáo dục, sức khoẻ tinh thần, tận dụng đất trống
entries.claim: Community gardens bring neighbours together and provide fresh food.

entries.label_vi: Sản phẩm thân thiện môi trường: ít ô nhiễm, thường bền hơn và tiết kiệm lâu dài, thúc đẩy doanh nghiệp
entries.claim: Environmentally friendly products reduce harm and often save money over time.
entries.because: They use less energy, create less waste and are often more durable, and growing demand encourages companies to improve their methods.
entries.result: A higher purchase price may be repaid through lower running costs.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề sản phẩm xanh vs rẻ.

entries.label_vi: Sản phẩm rẻ: ngân sách gia đình có hạn, 'xanh' đôi khi chỉ là quảng cáo
entries.claim: Many households simply cannot afford to pay extra for green products.
entries.because: When budgets are tight, families have to choose the cheapest option, and some products labelled green make claims that are exaggerated or hard to check.
entries.result: Cheap alternatives remain popular unless prices fall or rules improve.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề sản phẩm xanh vs rẻ.

entries.label_vi: Thời trang nhanh: sản xuất thừa, tốn nước, vải tổng hợp (vi nhựa), rác dệt may, điều kiện lao động kém
entries.claim: Fast fashion encourages people to buy more clothes than they need.
entries.because: Cheap, quickly changing styles lead to overproduction, high water and energy use, synthetic fibres that release microplastics, and large amounts of discarded clothing.
entries.result: The industry creates waste and pollution on a very large scale.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thời trang nhanh.

entries.label_vi: Tự làm / sửa chữa: kéo dài tuổi thọ đồ, giảm rác, tiết kiệm tiền, học kỹ năng
entries.claim: Do-it-yourself culture encourages people to repair and reuse instead of throwing away.
entries.because: Fixing a broken item, making furniture from old materials or sharing tools extends the life of products, saves money and teaches useful skills.
entries.result: Less waste is produced and fewer new goods have to be made.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề văn hoá tự làm / bền vững.

entries.label_vi: Tự làm có giới hạn: cần kỹ năng, thời gian, an toàn; quy mô nhỏ so với công nghiệp
entries.claim: The effect of do-it-yourself culture is limited.
entries.because: Not everyone has the skills, tools or time to repair things, some repairs are unsafe, and the largest environmental impacts come from industry and transport.
entries.result: It should complement, not replace, wider changes such as durable design.
entries.reuse_vi: Giới hạn của lập luận 'tự làm' / hành động cá nhân.

entries.label_vi: Nhãn tác động môi trường (carbon, nước, tái chế): người mua so sánh được, nhà sản xuất chịu áp lực cải thiện
entries.claim: Environmental impact labels help shoppers to compare products.
entries.because: A simple rating for carbon emissions, water use or recyclability lets buyers choose better options and puts pressure on producers to improve.
entries.result: Complicated or inconsistent labels, however, may confuse shoppers and add costs.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nhãn sản phẩm.

entries.label_vi: Giao thông công cộng giảm phát thải trên mỗi hành khách, giảm kẹt xe
entries.claim: Public transport carries many people with far less pollution per passenger.
entries.because: A full bus or train replaces dozens of cars, which reduces exhaust fumes, congestion and the space needed for roads.
entries.result: Cities become cleaner and quieter when people can rely on frequent services.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giao thông công cộng, ô nhiễm đô thị.

entries.label_vi: Nguyên nhân ô nhiễm không khí thành phố công nghiệp: nhà máy, nhà máy điện than, giao thông, bụi xây dựng
entries.claim: Factories, coal power stations and traffic are the main causes of air pollution in industrial cities.
entries.because: They release smoke, dust and gases such as sulphur dioxide and nitrogen oxides, and the problem is worse when cities are crowded or surrounded by hills that trap polluted air.
entries.result: Residents suffer from breathing problems, and the cost of health care rises.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề ô nhiễm không khí.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: giới hạn khí thải và bộ lọc, năng lượng sạch, giao thông sạch, giám sát và vành đai xanh
entries.claim: Strict emission limits and cleaner energy would reduce air pollution.
entries.because: Filters and emission limits cut what factories release, clean electricity replaces coal, and better public transport and electric vehicles reduce traffic fumes.
entries.result: Air quality monitoring and green belts help to track progress and absorb pollutants.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giải pháp ô nhiễm không khí.

entries.label_vi: Cách nhiệt nhà: tài trợ, vay lãi thấp, quy định cho nhà thuê, kiểm toán năng lượng miễn phí, giảm thuế
entries.claim: Governments can make home insulation cheaper and easier.
entries.because: Grants, low-interest loans and tax rebates remove the high upfront cost, rules for rented and new homes ensure minimum standards, and free energy checks show owners what to fix.
entries.result: Households save on heating bills and national emissions fall.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề cách nhiệt, tiết kiệm năng lượng gia đình.

entries.text: An efficient light bulb, for example, may cost more at first but lasts much longer and uses far less electricity.
A cheap dress that is worn twice and then thrown away, for example, wastes the water and energy used to make it.
A neighbourhood repair cafe, for instance, lets residents mend toasters and bicycles together instead of buying replacements.
A city with many coal-burning factories in a valley, for example, may be covered in smog for weeks in winter.
A family that insulates its loft and walls, for example, may notice a clear fall in its heating bills within a single winter.
